people.name: Jokneam
people.line: A Canaanite city, later a Levitical city in Zebulun

people.name: Kitron
people.line: A city in Zebulun not conquered

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

people.name: Zebulun
people.line: Israelite tribe, son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: To the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its pasture lands, Kartah with its pasture lands,
translations.bsb: This is what the Merarite clan (the rest of the Levites) were given: From the tribe of Zebulun they were given Jokneam, Kartah,
translations.kjv: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
translations.asv: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with its suburbs, and Kartah with its suburbs,
